sourceState: unpublished working-tree draft identified by source hashes
changes: Add actual target death and same-file exec checks at all 14 controlled retained ABI/mask recovery failures
Cover actual SIGKILL during ordinary LISTEN and before/after LISTEN request application
Verify both caller-reaped terminal statuses and recovery-owned exit notifications observed with WNOWAIT
Verify same-file exec after the caller consumes the actual EXEC event, including original PID/start time/executable inode equality
Compare every replacement GP/extended-state field and inherited signal mask, then release it to working console I/O
Require foreign-thread denial with the same ptrace owner and completed mmap intact
Require exactly 218 death and 182 exec assertions in a separate bounded native-gate child without relaxing existing deadlines

proofScope.execModel: The ptrace caller deliberately redirects a retained stopped task to its actual native exec site and consumes the real EXEC notification before recovery retry.
proofScope.memoryImageModel: Single-task exec retires the original mm; no separate CLONE_VM process keeps it alive.
proofScope.counting: Lifecycle assertions and normal-suite totals are separate; repeated setup assertions and builds are not counts of unique supported program features.

remaining: Asynchronous death/exec in every recovery race window
Nonleader exec TID replacement and old-mm keepalive by separate CLONE_VM processes
Foreign synchronous signals and syscall-user-dispatch policy
More restart classes, x32 and additional kernels
